pr_body:
cherry-pick #20386 to release-3.0

---

Signed-off-by: qupeng <qupeng@pingcap.com>

Close #20392 .

### What problem does this PR solve?

tidb_replica_read session variable can't work correctly in some situations:
* Value `leader-and-follower` makes same effect as `follower`, which is not expected

### What is changed and how it works?

* Use correct `ReplicaReadType` when get rpc context

### Related changes

### Check List <!--REMOVE the items that are not applicable-->

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- Unit test

Side effects

### Release note <!-- bugfixes or new feature need a release note -->
* make session var tidb_replica_read work correctly
pr_comments: This feature is not included in release-3.0. So the PR can be closed.
Close this PR since 'follower read' is not supported in 3.0

issue_context.title: sessionvar `tidb_replica_read` doesn't work as expected
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)
1. set the session variable `tidb_replica_read` to `leader-and-follower`
2. run some queries



### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)
Coprocessor (or point get) tasks should be sent to both leader and follower replicas

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)
Tasks are only sent to follower replicas

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)
master branch
